source_context: Bank settlement reconciliation uses nearest cent rounding with ties to even: an exact half cent chooses the even integer minor unit.
Merchant invoice line amounts use nearest cent rounding with exact half cents rounded away from zero, including negative refund lines.
Legacy ledger import truncates all fractional cents toward zero, discarding the fraction without rounding up for positive or negative amounts.
